pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against adding to positions within 30 seconds of a prior entry or during active expansion wicks to prevent compounding losses.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Multi-timeframe liquidity sweep confirmation plus zero high-impact scheduled macroeconomic releases within 15 minutes of execution.
profit_harvest_threshold: Trigger trailing stops instantly once floating profit hits +$15.00 to lock in asymmetric rewards of +$15 to +$30.
